name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem you're trying to solve.

Example: "I need to access the [...] register but the library doesn't expose it" or "It would be helpful to [...]".

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen — the register, peripheral, or accessor to add.

Please make sure the addition belongs to the **ARM Cortex-M0 core** itself (NVIC, SCB, SysTick, special registers,
etc.). Device-specific peripherals (UART, GPIO, timers on a particular MCU) belong in a device support package,
not in this core library.

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, links to the relevant ARM documentation, or datasheet references here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched for similar feature requests
- [ ] The proposed addition is part of the Cortex-M0 core, not a device-specific peripheral
- [ ] I am willing to help implement this feature (optional)
